undeclared.decision: A boolean observation is satisfied when its key is absent from both failure lists, regardless of its raw boolean value. Non-boolean observations are unknown. Gains require failed-to-satisfied transitions; losses require satisfied-to-failed transitions; transitions involving unknown are reported only as unknown.
undeclared.why_it_matters: This defines the behavior comparisons and freeze-admission gate. Treating false forbidden effects as satisfied is appropriate, but this scoring convention and treatment of unknown transitions are absent from A-002/A-009.

stale_rows.stated: The first integrity error stops the campaign.
stale_rows.actual: Pre-launch verify failures and CLI-version mismatches raise without saving a stopped state or error. The campaign retains its previous actionable status and can continue after the files or CLI version are restored.
stale_rows.why_it_matters: The persisted lifecycle permits continuing a campaign that the ledger says must stop. Either make these failures terminal or explicitly distinguish retryable pre-launch rejection from terminal in-flight failure.

defects.decision: Campaign persistence records a session as prepared before launching, while running status and delivery information are persisted only to its execution manifest.
defects.why_it_matters: During execution, the campaign API continues reporting prepared. After a crash, recover() updates only running jobs, so an actually launched session remains prepared inside the interrupted campaign. The UI also excludes prepared sessions from unknown-usage counts.

resolved_findings.finding: Cancellation returns no campaign id, but mutate previously assigned response.id to location.hash, producing #undefined and breaking selected-record polling.
resolved_findings.disposition: Resolved during review: mutate now preserves selection when the response lacks id. Executing the actual function with a mocked cancellation response preserved the campaign hash. A browser cancellation regression check was also added; I did not execute that browser check.

confirmed_correct: A/B prompt construction shares the task, approved Contract and reminders; routed B appends the frozen text, and fallback produces identical prompts.
HTTP execution routes retain Host/Origin checks and the required same-origin JSON header. Model configuration is passed as subprocess arguments without shell interpolation.
Test execution does not invoke reflection or update the experience library.
A-010 now declares the implementation and CLI-version drift checks.
